requirement.description: The Flask hook implementation doesn't properly detect and hook Flask applications that are created dynamically in test modules. The hook_flask function currently passes an empty list to the generic hook mechanism, but it should detect Flask app instances from the test modules themselves.
requirement.contract: When a Flask application is created in a test module (like tests/test_server_hook_flask.py), the hook_flask function should detect the Flask app instance and properly hook its view functions and error handlers. The hook should work regardless of how the Flask app is instantiated (whether via create_app() function or directly).

requirement.description: The generic hook mechanism doesn't properly detect Flask applications that are created within test modules, particularly when they're created in functions like create_app() rather than at module level.
requirement.contract: The hook_generic function should be enhanced to detect Flask applications created in test modules by examining the module attributes and looking for Flask app instances that have route and error handler definitions, even when they are created inside functions rather than at module level.
